`task` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Runs one scoped repository task from stream orientation through taskSession/worktree work, test-first implementation, verification, publishing, stream PR promotion, and cleanup.

## When to use it

Invoke when the user asks to start, run, validate, publish, promote, inspect, recover, or finish repo/task-scoped work in a stream.

Typical requests include:

- “Start this scoped repo task on the approved stream.”
- “Validate, publish, and finish the current task.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill task
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill task
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/task/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

Task Workflow executes one concrete work unit. It should not decide a large epic decomposition that belongs in Branch Planner.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/task/SKILL.md` exists and that `task` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `task` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
